Because most UI-test harnesses don\'t wipe app storage between consecutive test executions, the counter keeps climbing test-run over test-run, and the button silently disappears on whichever two out of every five runs land on a `prior % 5` of 2 or 4 — producing the reported "passes ~3 times out of 5" pattern. The fix (test-side) is to `pm clear` (or otherwise reset app state) before each test invocation, or to have the test avoid asserting on the button when `launchCount % 5` is 2 or 4.'
